page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr8i.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 6462C processor operating at a base frequency of 3.3 GHz. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This server type does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, facilitating efficient data transfer between instances and external services. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses or dedicated GPU hardware are bundled with this configuration.

Given its high memory density of 8.0 GB per vCPU, the ecs.hfr8i.8xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity without the overhead of local storage or GPU accelerators. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance. This profile is suitable for memory-intensive applications, including in-memory databases, caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and large-scale data processing tasks.

It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage for data persistence. This hardware configuration is designed for memory-intensive enterprise workloads, such as in-memory databases, large-scale caching layers, and data analytics pipelines that require consistent, dedicated CPU performance and a high memory-to-vCPU ratio.
